messages.content:
Divine Sense
Class
The presence of strong evil registers on your senses like a noxious odor, and powerful good rings like heavenly music in your ears. As an action, you can open your awareness to detect such forces. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover. You know the type (celestial, fiend, or undead) of any being whose presence you sense, but not its identity (the vampire Count Strahd von Zarovich, for instance). Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the hallow spell.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. When you finish a long rest, you regain all expended uses.

messages.content:
Axe of Xander
This is a sentient, lawful neutral +21d20+2 greataxe (Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 10). It has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 120 feet. It communicates empathically by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or using it.
The axe’s primary purpose is to destroy giants and titans. When you attack one of those creatures you score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. When attacking giants or titans Axe of Xander also deals an extra 2d62d6 force damage. It also transmits a tremendous sense of satisfaction and wellbeing to its user when it kills a giant or titan. You may heal 2d102d10 Hit Points when this happens.
This greataxe has 9 charges. As long as the weapon has at least 1 charge, attacks you make with it deal an extra 1d61d6 force damage to any target it hits. When you score a critical hit on an attack roll made with this weapon, it regains 3 expended charges.
Forceful Slash. When you take the Attack action using this axe, you can forgo one of your attacks to expend 3 or more of the greataxe's charges to slash the air in front you. When you do, a 30-foot cone of force emits from the blade. Creatures within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d61d6 force damage for each expended charge. If you expend 4 or more charges in this way and leave the Axe of Xander with 0 remaining charges, the weapon realses even more powerful wave of force. When it happens, targets within the area of effect take an extra 3d63d6 force damage, and creatures that succeed on the Dexterity saving throw take half damage instead of avoiding the effect, creatures that fail on the Dexterity Saving Throw are knocked prone. The DC for this property's saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the number of charges you expend.

messages.content:
Grasping Vine (2024)
4th Level Conjuration
Casting Time1 bonus action
Durationup to 1 minute
ComponentsV, S
Range30ft.
ConcentrationRequires Concentration
You conjure a vine that sprouts from a surface in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The vine lasts for the duration.
Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of the vine. On a hit, the target takes 4d84d8 Bludgeoning damage and is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine; if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). The vine can grapple only one creature at a time, and you can cause the vine to release a Grappled creature (no action required).
As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can repeat the attack against a creature within 30 feet of the vine.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of creatures the vine can grapple increases by one for each spell slot level above 4.
Range: 30ft.

messages.content:
Odkupienie Pythora
This mighty weapon was crafted by Orion Xul and Volkan, God of Forges in legendary Mithral Forge.

Immediately after you make a ranged attack with this weapon, it flies back to your hand.
Whenever you roll a 20 on your attack roll with this weapon, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target takes 5 lightning damage.
You gain a +11d20+1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this weapon. On a hit, the weapon deals an extra 1d61d6 lightning damage.

Fated EnhancementsPythor's Redemption was further improved by a deal with the Fates, into which the Demgod wove threads of their own manhood.

The weapon’s bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +21d20+2, and the extra lightning damage dealt by the weapon increases to 2d62d6.
As an action, you can unleash a 30-foot cone of destructive energy from the weapon. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d68d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once this action is used, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

messages.content:
Shield Wall
action
You can use a bonus action to activate your Shield Wall ability. You may use this ability once, and you regain the ability to do so after completing a long rest. For 1 minute, you and every ally who can see or hear you gains +21d20+2 AC as long as they are standing within 5 feet of an ally who is using a shield. Additionally, your allies wielding shields gain an additional +11d20+1 AC from their own shields (this includes you).

messages.content:
Rime's Binding Ice (Crown of the Dragonlords) Evocation

A burst of cold energy emanates from you in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 cold damage and is hindered by ice formations for 1 minute, or until it or another creature within reach of it uses an action to break away the ice. A creature hindered by ice has its speed reduced to 0. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t hindered by ice.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, increase the cold damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

Materials a vial of meltwater

messages.content:
Odkupienie Pythora
This mighty weapon was crafted by Orion Xul and Volkan, God of Forges in legendary Mithral Forge.

Immediately after you make a ranged attack with this weapon, it flies back to your hand.
Whenever you roll a 20 on your attack roll with this weapon, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target takes 5 lightning damage.
You gain a +11d20+1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this weapon. On a hit, the weapon deals an extra 1d61d6 lightning damage.

Fated EnhancementsPythor's Redemption was further improved by a deal with the Fates, into which the Demgod wove threads of their own manhood.

The weapon’s bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +21d20+2, and the extra lightning damage dealt by the weapon increases to 2d62d6.
As an action, you can unleash a 30-foot cone of destructive energy from the weapon. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d68d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once this action is used, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

messages.content:
Axe of Xander
This is a sentient, lawful neutral +21d20+2 greataxe (Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10, Charisma 10). It has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 120 feet. It communicates empathically by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or using it.
The axe’s primary purpose is to destroy giants and titans. When you attack one of those creatures you score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. When attacking giants or titans Axe of Xander also deals an extra 2d62d6 force damage. It also transmits a tremendous sense of satisfaction and wellbeing to its user when it kills a giant or titan. You may heal 2d102d10 Hit Points when this happens.
This greataxe has 9 charges. As long as the weapon has at least 1 charge, attacks you make with it deal an extra 1d61d6 force damage to any target it hits. When you score a critical hit on an attack roll made with this weapon, it regains 3 expended charges.
Forceful Slash. When you take the Attack action using this axe, you can forgo one of your attacks to expend 3 or more of the greataxe's charges to slash the air in front you. When you do, a 30-foot cone of force emits from the blade. Creatures within range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d61d6 force damage for each expended charge. If you expend 4 or more charges in this way and leave the Axe of Xander with 0 remaining charges, the weapon realses even more powerful wave of force. When it happens, targets within the area of effect take an extra 3d63d6 force damage, and creatures that succeed on the Dexterity saving throw take half damage instead of avoiding the effect, creatures that fail on the Dexterity Saving Throw are knocked prone. The DC for this property's saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the number of charges you expend.

messages.content:
Starry Form: Dragon
action
2nd-level Circle of the Stars feature
As a bonus action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form, rather than transforming into a beast.
While in your starry form, you retain your game statistics, but your body becomes luminous; your joints glimmer like stars, and glowing lines connect them as on a star chart. This form sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The form lasts for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), are incapacitated, die, or use this feature again.
Whenever you assume your starry form, choose which of the following constellations glimmers on your body; your choice gives you certain benefits while in the form:
Archer. A constellation of an archer appears on you. When you activate this form, and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns while it lasts, you can make a ranged spell attack, hurling a luminous arrow that targets one creature within 60 feet of you. On a hit, the attack deals radiant damage equal to 1d81d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
Chalice. A constellation of a life-giving goblet appears on you. Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet of you can regain hit points equal to 1d81d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
Dragon. A constellation of a wise dragon appears on you. When you make an Intelligence or a Wisdom check or a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20d20 as a 10.

messages.content:
Notatka Tarana

W kompleksie świątynnym na tej przeklętej Samotnej Wyspie ukrywa się stworzenie o znacznej mocy. Może być przebrane, spowite jakąś zwodniczą iluzją. Załączony kamień zdejmie wszelkie takie iluzje – użyj go, gdy będziesz blisko.

Przynieś mi głowę tej bestii do Mytros, a twoja nagroda będzie wysoka. Wdzięczność mojej rodziny czeka.

Jeśli któryś z twoich ludzi padnie ofiarą jakiegoś trwałego uroku na wyspie – niektórzy mówią, że samo powietrze jest tam przeklęte – słyszałem szepty, że uspokojenie... loków... tego stworzenia może odwrócić takie efekty. Być może masz wystarczająco przekonującego głupca do takiego zadania, gdyby zaszła potrzeba. Skup się jednak na głównym celu.

Taran Neurdagon
